product.name: a2a
product.lede: a2a holds the A2A (Agent2Agent) protocol v1.0.1 as an ESS specification: the task lifecycle, messages, push-notification configs and the extended Agent Card. OpenAPI, AsyncAPI and JSON Schema documents and a Rust crate are generated from it, and task check fails when any of them drifts. Each rule ESS cannot hold yet is marked UNMAPPED beside the place it belongs.
product.description: The A2A protocol v1.0.1 as an ESS specification, with a2a.proto and the OpenAPI, AsyncAPI and JSON Schema documents generated from it.
product.meta: ESS specification · OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, JSON Schema · Rust · Apache-2.0

sections.title: One specification, the documents generated from it.
sections.lede: Every page under Reference and every file under Downloads is generated from the repository by a2a-docs, and task check fails when one of them differs from what the repository generates.

items.title: UNMAPPED markers
